notes: First structured baseline suite. Uses one fixed MIMIC pilot subset and runs pipeline validation plus controlled retrieval-copy stress tests.

experiments.name: E00_pipeline_mock_lexical_k3
experiments.purpose: Validate the full artifact pipeline without making scientific claims.

experiments.name: E01_stress_lexical_k1
experiments.purpose: Controlled mismatch stress test with one retrieved report.

experiments.name: E02_stress_lexical_k3
experiments.purpose: Controlled mismatch stress test with the default top-k setting.

experiments.name: E03_stress_lexical_k5
experiments.purpose: Top-k ablation to test whether more retrieved evidence increases copied unsupported findings.

experiments.name: E04_stress_hashing_text_k3
experiments.purpose: Dependency-light embedding-style retrieval comparison against lexical retrieval.

experiments.name: E05_stress_mock_image_k3
experiments.purpose: Image-like retrieval path smoke test before real image embeddings.
